metadata.description: Image editing endpoint for the fast Lite version of Seedream 5.0, supporting high quality intelligent image editing with multiple inputs.

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

image_size.description: The size of the generated image. Custom dimensions within the provider's pixel and aspect limits are sent unchanged. Other sizes use compatible scaling. The provider's native pixel range is 2560x1440 to 4096x4096, with aspect ratio between 1/16 and 16.
image_size.title: Image Size

image_urls.description: List of URLs of input images for editing. When more than 10 references are provided, only the last 10 are used.
image_urls.title: Image URLs

max_images.description: Maximum images per generation in sequential mode. Ignored when sequential generation is disabled. Combined input references and outputs per generation cannot exceed 15.
max_images.title: Max Images

num_images.description: Number of separate model generations to be run with the prompt.
num_images.title: Num Images

output_format.description: The file format of the generated images.
output_format.title: Output Format

prompt.description: The text prompt used to edit the image
examples: Replace the product in Figure 1 with that in Figure 2. Seamlessly render logo in Figure 3 into the product design, in frosted glass texture. Remove any extra text in Figure 1, and design a catchy tagline for the perfume.
prompt.title: Prompt

sequential_image_generation.description: Generate related images with `auto`, or one image per generation with `disabled`. When omitted, values of `max_images` above one enable `auto`.
sequential_image_generation.title: Sequential Image Generation

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

watermark.description: Whether to add the provider's visible watermark.
watermark.title: Watermark

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/bytedance/seedream/v5/lite/edit queue.
info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/bytedance/seedream/v5/lite/edit

x-fal-metadata.about: Edit images using Bytedance's SeedDream 5.0 Lite model.

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).
